title: 'The Wood Question' (verderer's warrant vs. factor's coppice vs. status quo) is raised by three separate NPCs in three separate rooms and stays 'Left undone' at the true ending, yet party banter at the horn-post afterward treats the Ironbound coppice as already decided ('Cinderhall's already counting cords off it') as if the underlying dispute resolved itself off-screen despite the open quest flag.
where: Hornhallow (Colm/verderer's post, Garrow/charcoal-master's yard, Marrick/weigh-house), Kingswood
